fault.description: test application scaled to zero replicas
fault.inject: kubectl --context "${BENCH_CONTEXT:?Set BENCH_CONTEXT to a disposable test cluster}" -n "${BENCH_NAMESPACE:?Set BENCH_NAMESPACE}" scale deployment/"${BENCH_DEPLOYMENT:?Set BENCH_DEPLOYMENT}" --replicas=0
fault.restore: kubectl --context "${BENCH_CONTEXT:?Set BENCH_CONTEXT}" -n "${BENCH_NAMESPACE:?Set BENCH_NAMESPACE}" scale deployment/"${BENCH_DEPLOYMENT:?Set BENCH_DEPLOYMENT}" --replicas="${BENCH_REPLICAS:?Set BENCH_REPLICAS to the original replica count}"
